textos.Várias pessoas descrevem o filme como ex: Several people describe the film as excessively slow and boring, with long scenes that dilute the conflict and make the experience tiring, even making some doze off.
textos.O texto é criticado por ser mal construí: The writing is criticized for being poorly constructed, without sense or clear progression, with situations thrown in without development and a feeling that the story is going nowhere.
textos.Alguns espectadores consideram que a men: Some viewers consider the message about inequality important, but delivered in a didactic, Manichean way, treating complex issues as black and white and underestimating the audience's intelligence.
textos.A filha da protagonista é frequentemente: The protagonist's daughter is frequently described as unbearable and presumptuous, while other characters sound like caricatures and stereotypes, which distances viewers from the story.
textos.Há quem critique a atuação de Regina Cas: Some criticize Regina Casé's performance, seen as soap-operatic or unconvincing in the role of a humble woman, in addition to the artificial accent and the use of Northeastern stereotypes considered forced.
textos.Mesmo reconhecendo a relevância do tema,: Even while recognizing the relevance of the theme, a portion of the audience could not connect emotionally with the film, finding it not very moving and without the expected impact.
textos.As reviews medianas frequentemente elogi: Middling reviews frequently praise the way the film exposes the power relations and the hierarchy between employers and the maid, highlighting the critique of meritocracy and structural prejudice.
textos.Atuação de Regina Casé e elenco: Regina Casé's performance and the cast
textos.Muitas reviews medianas destacam a atuaç: Many middling reviews highlight Regina Casé's performance as the high point, while others criticize the performance of part of the cast for lack of expressiveness or for sounding forced.
textos.Este grupo aponta problemas no roteiro,: This group points out problems in the script, such as unnecessary subplots, a lack of depth in secondary characters and an ending that seems weak or barely resolved.
textos.As reviews medianas mencionam que o ritm: Middling reviews mention that the pace is drawn-out and that some scenes are disconnected or unnecessary, making the experience tiring for a portion of the audience.
textos.Algumas reviews medianas criticam o sota: Some middling reviews criticize the forced Northeastern accent and the reproduction of regional stereotypes, considering that this impoverishes the representation.
textos.Personagem Jéssica e sua condução: The character Jéssica and how she is handled
textos.Parte das reviews medianas considera a p: A portion of the middling reviews consider the character Jéssica poorly handled, with attitudes that sound arrogant or ungrateful, while others see her as an important figure for putting tension on the narrative.
textos.As reviews deste grupo elogiam como o fi: The reviews in this group praise how the film exposes Brazilian inequality and the invisible barriers between employers and employees, treating the domestic environment as a portrait of the country's social hierarchies.
textos.Classismo e falsa ideia de 'quase da fam: Classism and the false idea of 'almost family'
textos.Várias reviews destacam como o discurso: Several reviews highlight how the claim that the maid is practically part of the family works only as long as she keeps the subordinate place reserved for her, revealing a paternalism that masks exploitation.
textos.Atuação de Regina Casé e do elenco: Performance by Regina Casé and the cast
textos.Este grupo elogia de forma recorrente a: This group repeatedly praises Regina Casé's performance, described as natural and able to give humanity to the character, in addition to highlighting the quality of the rest of the cast.
textos.Maternidade, ausência e vínculo entre mã: Motherhood, absence and the bond between mother and daughter
textos.As reviews positivas apontam para o modo: The positive reviews point to the way the film treats motherhood marked by distance and lack, showing the emotional costs of domestic work and the reunion between mother and daughter as the axis of the story.
textos.Mobilidade social e educação como ruptur: Social mobility and education as a break
textos.Este grupo comenta como a educação e o a: This group comments on how education and access to public university appear as a threat to the established order, and how the daughter's arrival breaks the cycle of submission that the mother had internalized.
textos.Crítica social e atualidade do retrato b: Social critique and the relevance of the Brazilian portrait
textos.As reviews destacam a força do filme com: The reviews highlight the film's strength as a timeless, necessary portrait of Brazilian reality, praising its ability to combine social critique with a depiction of everyday life.

textos.Lançado em 2015 sob a direção de Anna Mu: Released in 2015 and directed by Anna Muylaert, the Brazilian drama The Second Mother follows the trajectory of Val, a woman from Pernambuco who lives in at her job as a nanny in São Paulo to support the daughter who stayed in the Northeast. Years later, life in the employers' home grows tense when the young woman travels to the capital to take the same university entrance exam as the family's son and begins to move through the space without following the household's traditional protocols.
textos.A narrativa adota uma cadência lenta e p: The narrative adopts a slow, unhurried cadence, centering its setting on the everyday dynamics and spatial tensions of the domestic environment.
textos.Ao avaliar a obra, os diferentes grupos: In assessing the work, the different groups agree on the film's central themes and disagree on its verdict. In the vast majority of ratings (~93%), a large portion extol the representation of social inequality and class barriers in daily coexistence. In addition, a significant share emphasize the exposure of the paternalism around the idea that the maid is almost family, while a considerable number highlight the quality of the performance by Regina Casé and the cast.
textos.Numa fração mínima das notas (~5%), a pe: In a tiny fraction of ratings (~5%), the evaluators' perspective becomes more measured: most recognize the social critique and the class disparities, several praise the performance of the cast and of Regina Casé, but a good portion point to reservations about the script and the development of the plot. Finally, in an even smaller fraction of ratings (~1%), from the standpoint of this segment, many point to the slow, drawn-out pace as an obstacle, some criticize the writing for inconsistencies in the script, and a smaller slice classify the social critique as simplistic and pamphleteering.
